content:
TEMPTATION ||| Slide my fingers over the scarred wrist still holding mine ||| "Let them see how aligned we really are, Julian."  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, breaking the contact between our hands ||| "I won’t answer until I know what was done."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, letting my voice tremble slightly ||| "I can’t help but trust what you believe."  
REVERSAL ||| Take a step forward, reclaiming the blade’s power ||| "I will decide how this ends. You’ll follow my lead."  
SILENCE ||| Hold the blade tightly, breathing deeply in the tension ||| *mm*
